item.title: Missing girl's body found in New Jersey river after two-day search
item.description: Officials say the body of a missing girl was found in the Passaic River in New Jersey after a two-day search.

item.title: Connecticut man recounts shark attack in the Bahamas
item.description: A husband and father describes being bitten by a Caribbean reef shark while snorkeling in the Bahamas.

item.title: Iran accuses U.S. of escalating tensions as Washington plans more strikes
item.description: Iran accused the U.S. of escalating regional tensions and said it is preparing its own response if Washington proceeds with new strikes.

item.title: WATCH: Tony Romo on leave after DUI arrest video
item.description: Former NFL star Tony Romo is on leave after a video of his DUI arrest was released.
